name: dagger_in
note: Fire Daggers: crouched knife stance, inward cut (0.45 s) then a backhand cut back (1.25 s), returns to stance

name: dagger_out
note: Fire Daggers: outward cut, the body turns into it, returns to stance

name: dagger_stab
note: Fire Daggers: a stab with the lead hand, then a cut back across

name: blade_spin
note: Fire Blade finisher: the body spins into a wide two-armed slash, then settles back to stance
